about.page_title: Kuhusu PenePene - Soko lako la ndani
about.hero_subtitle: Soko kuu la ndani linalounganisha wanunuzi na wauzaji nchini DRC — kufanya biashara iwe rahisi, ya kuaminika na karibu nawe.

about.story_p1: In Congo, millions of talented entrepreneurs sell great products — but struggle to reach customers beyond their neighbourhood. At the same time, buyers waste hours searching for items that are available just streets away.
about.story_p2_after: in Lingala — was born to bridge this gap. We built a platform where any seller can list their products in minutes and any buyer can discover them instantly.
about.story_p3: No complicated shipping. No foreign platforms. Just local commerce, done right.
about.feature_verified_desc: Every seller is reviewed and verified before going live.
about.feature_fast_desc: Find exactly what you need in seconds with smart search.

about.mission_text: To empower every Congolese entrepreneur with a digital storefront and every buyer with instant access to local products — making commerce accessible, trusted, and rewarding for all.

faq.q: How do I track my order?
faq.a: You can track your order status from your Buyer Dashboard under "My Orders". Each order shows its current status in real time.

faq.q: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a: On any product page, click the "Message Seller" button. This opens a direct chat with the seller where you can discuss price, availability and delivery.

faq.q: What do I do if I have a problem with my order?
faq.a: Open a support ticket from your dashboard or use the contact form on this page. Our team responds within 24 hours.

faq.q: How do I become a seller on PenePene?
faq.a: Click "Become a Seller" in the navigation or visit /become-a-seller. Fill in your business details and our team will review and verify your account.

How to search and filter products

faq.q: How do I create an account on PenePene?
faq.a: Click "Sign In" in the top navigation, then choose "Create Account". Fill in your name, email and password. You'll receive a verification email — click the link to activate your account.

faq.q: How do I contact a seller?
faq.a: Go to any product page and click the "Message Seller" button. This opens a private chat where you can discuss price, availability, and delivery directly with the seller.

faq.q: How do I become a seller on PenePene?
faq.a: Visit /become-a-seller or click "Sell on PenePene" in the top bar. Complete the seller registration form with your business details. Our team will review and verify your account within 24–48 hours.

Currently, PenePene facilitates discovery and communication between buyers and sellers. Payment arrangements are made directly between buyer and seller. We are working on integrated payment solutions.

faq.q: How do I publish a product listing?
faq.a: Log into your Seller Dashboard, go to "Products" and click "Add Product". Fill in the title, description, price, category and upload photos. Your listing goes live after our moderation review (usually under 12 hours).

faq.q: How do I reset my password?
faq.a: On the login page, click "Forgot Password". Enter your registered email address and we'll send you a secure reset link. The link expires after 60 minutes.

faq.q: How can I report a seller or product?
faq.a: On any seller's store page or product page, click the "Report" button. Select the reason (fake product, scam, inappropriate content, etc.) and submit. Our moderation team will review within 24 hours.

faq.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it?
faq.a: Yes, you can cancel an order while it is still in "Pending" status. Go to your Buyer Dashboard > Orders, open the order, and click "Cancel Order". Once the seller confirms the order, cancellation requires seller approval.
